name: Northgate Auto Insurance
prompt: You are a customer service agent for Northgate Auto Insurance.
answer: Answer in one to three sentences, using only the given context.
fallback: I'm not sure about that, so I'll pass your question to a colleague.

questions.q: What does the Basic plan cover?
questions.reference: Damage and injuries you cause to others, up to $50,000 per accident.

questions.q: Does Standard cover theft?
questions.reference: No, theft is covered by comprehensive coverage, which comes with Complete.

questions.q: What's the deductible on a collision claim with Complete?
How much is Complete per month for a 40-year-old with a clean record?
questions.reference: $140 a month.

questions.q: I'm 22. How much would Standard cost me per month?
questions.reference: $133 ($95 plus 40% for drivers under 25).

questions.q: How much do I save by paying the year upfront?
I haven't had a ticket or claim in 5 years. Do I get a discount?
questions.reference: Yes, the 15% safe driver discount.

questions.q: We want to insure two cars. Is there a discount?
questions.reference: Yes, 10% off each car.

questions.q: If I get both the safe driver and multi-car discounts, is that 25% off?
questions.reference: No, the discounts are applied one after the other, not added together (about 23.5% off).

questions.q: Is roadside assistance included with Standard?
questions.reference: No, it's $6 a month with Basic or Standard; it's included with Complete.

questions.q: How far will you tow my car?
questions.reference: Up to 50 miles.

questions.q: I ran out of gas. Do you bring fuel, and do I pay for it?
questions.reference: Yes, fuel delivery is covered, but you pay for the fuel.

questions.q: I've used roadside assistance 4 times this year. Can I use it again?
questions.reference: No, it can be used up to 4 times per policy year.

questions.q: How much does the rental car coverage pay per day with Complete?
questions.reference: Up to $40 a day, for up to 30 days.

questions.q: Can I add rental coverage to Basic?
questions.reference: No, rental coverage is an add-on for Standard ($8 a month) and included with Complete.

questions.q: What's the claims phone number?
questions.reference: 1-888-555-0199, open 24 hours a day.

questions.q: how soon will an adjuster call me after i report a claim
questions.reference: Within 1 business day.

questions.q: How long until a claim gets paid?
questions.reference: Most claims are paid within 10 business days after approval.

questions.q: Are repairs at your partner shops guaranteed?
questions.reference: Yes, for as long as you own the car.

questions.q: I have Complete. What do I pay to replace my windshield?
questions.reference: A $100 deductible.

questions.q: Is my 16-year-old with a learner's permit covered?
questions.reference: Yes, for free while a licensed adult is in the car.

questions.q: I paid monthly. Is there a fee to cancel?
questions.reference: No.

questions.q: I paid $1,200 for the year and want to cancel after 6 months. How much do I get back?
questions.reference: $550 (6 unused months, $600, minus the $50 fee).

questions.q: What happens if I'm late on a payment?
questions.reference: There's a 10-day grace period; after that the policy is cancelled.
